compiler_compatibility.description: Current V compatibility aliases and conditional placement; these are the canonical source forms used by the recorded checks.

limits: Counts include no-ops and conservative declines.
Direct spatial image filters still decline integer source rectangles with nonintegral mappings, out-of-bounds source rectangles and nonfinite/out-of-range paint alpha.
HTML still rounds source rectangles before its service call.
Rotated layers, spatial chains containing multiple blur/shadow nodes beyond the supported blur lists, SVG graphs, large-sigma rescaling, tiled surfaces and native bridges retain Skia dependencies.
No Skia-free browser compile/link/run is claimed.
